test_title: PYST 35: SSC MTS - Reasoning (Held on: 7 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the figure that will replace the question mark (?) in the following figure series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ccd97d5aa67eeaeec54846902175baf1aa54f22abbb588e1decda2fff2a20eae.png]
solution:
The figure that will replace the question mark (?) in the following figure series is shown below:

1) Small figure series move one by one in the right direction and the last position small figure move in the first position.

2) Lower left side small figure move lower right side and flip vertically.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/df5b7378d4f9bdc4ae3c75f78f566912da5bc7f09564dbea14e455ae1c08989e.png] 

Final series is

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4ab8dc35d0ee9097b02785b7f35139045c95ab097b9c6384959efcc677ea5bc1.png] 

Hence, **‘option 3’** is the correct answer.
